goal: Verify that a user can successfully create a new account, navigate the calendar to the next month, and access the settings menu via the settings button.

findings.instruction: Once logged in and viewing the calendar (initially showing June 2026), click the 'Next month' button (right arrow) located next to the month title to navigate to July 2026.
findings.title: Calendar did not navigate to July 2026 after clicking Next month button
findings.description: The instruction was to click the 'Next month' button to navigate from June 2026 to July 2026. However, the calendar still displays 'June 2026' in the AFTER screenshot, indicating the navigation action did not execute or the state did not update.
findings.evidence: In both the BEFORE and AFTER screenshots, the calendar header clearly shows 'June 2026'. The expected state after the action should show 'July 2026'.
reproduction_steps: Log in and view the dashboard with the calendar showing June 2026.
Click the right arrow ('Next month') button next to the month title.
Observe that the calendar still displays 'June 2026' instead of 'July 2026'.
